"""
Unit and integration tests for GCE Batch Worker.
Covers data transformation logic, statistical summarizer, checksum calculations,
metadata retrieval, Cloud Storage/PubSub REST client interactions, and shutdown triggers.
"""

import base64
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import urllib.error
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, call, patch
import pytest

import worker


# =========================================================================
# 1. Structured Logging Tests
# =========================================================================

def test_log_json_emits_valid_json(capsys):
    """log_json should output a single line of valid JSON containing timestamp, severity, and message."""
    worker.log_json("INFO", "Processing record batch", job_id="job-123", count=42)
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    output_lines = [line for line in captured.out.splitlines() if line.strip()]
    assert len(output_lines) == 1

    payload = json.loads(output_lines[0])
    assert payload["severity"] == "INFO"
    assert payload["message"] == "Processing record batch"
    assert payload["job_id"] == "job-123"
    assert payload["count"] == 42
    assert "timestamp" in payload


# =========================================================================
# 2. Data Transformation & Statistical Summarizer Tests
# =========================================================================

def test_transform_records_with_list(sample_records_list):
    """transform_records calculates accurate counts, schema fields, and numeric summaries for record lists."""
    raw_bytes = json.dumps(sample_records_list).encode("utf-8")
    record_count, meta = worker.transform_records(raw_bytes)

    assert record_count == 3
    assert meta["parsed_records"] == 3
    assert meta["total_records"] == 3
    assert sorted(meta["schema_fields"]) == ["active", "id", "metric_a", "metric_b", "region"]

    # Verify numeric summarizer (booleans must not be counted as numeric)
    metrics = meta["numeric_metrics"]
    assert "active" not in metrics
    assert "id" not in metrics

    # metric_a: [10.5, 20.5, 15.0] -> sum: 46.0, count: 3, mean: 15.3333
    assert metrics["metric_a"]["sum"] == 46.0
    assert metrics["metric_a"]["count"] == 3
    assert metrics["metric_a"]["mean"] == 15.3333

    # metric_b: [100, 200, 300] -> sum: 600.0, count: 3, mean: 200.0
    assert metrics["metric_b"]["sum"] == 600.0
    assert metrics["metric_b"]["count"] == 3
    assert metrics["metric_b"]["mean"] == 200.0


@pytest.mark.parametrize("wrapper_key", ["records", "items", "payload"])
def test_transform_records_nested_dict(wrapper_key):
    """transform_records extracts lists from common dictionary wrapping keys."""
    nested_data = {
        wrapper_key: [
            {"val": 10, "tag": "a"},
            {"val": 30, "tag": "b"},
        ]
    }
    raw_bytes = json.dumps(nested_data).encode("utf-8")
    record_count, meta = worker.transform_records(raw_bytes)

    assert record_count == 2
    assert meta["parsed_records"] == 2
    assert meta["numeric_metrics"]["val"]["sum"] == 40.0
    assert meta["numeric_metrics"]["val"]["mean"] == 20.0


def test_transform_records_single_dict():
    """transform_records handles a single dictionary object as a single record."""
    single_record = {"reading": 98.6, "patient": "p-101"}
    raw_bytes = json.dumps(single_record).encode("utf-8")
    count, meta = worker.transform_records(raw_bytes)

    assert count == 1
    assert meta["parsed_records"] == 1
    assert meta["schema_fields"] == ["patient", "reading"]
    assert meta["numeric_metrics"]["reading"]["mean"] == 98.6


def test_transform_records_raw_unparseable_lines():
    """Non-JSON raw bytes gracefully fall back to line counting."""
    raw_text = b"first line\nsecond line\n\nthird line\n"
    count, meta = worker.transform_records(raw_text)

    assert count == 3
    assert meta == {"line_count": 3, "format": "raw_lines"}


def test_transform_records_scalar_json():
    """Scalar JSON values (e.g., number or string) are handled safely."""
    raw_bytes = json.dumps(12345).encode("utf-8")
    count, meta = worker.transform_records(raw_bytes)

    assert count == 1
    assert meta["parsed_records"] == 0
    assert meta["numeric_metrics"] == {}


# =========================================================================
# 3. Checksum Calculations Tests
# =========================================================================

def test_checksum_calculations():
    """Verify SHA-256 and MD5 checksum parity against Python standard hashlib."""
    payload = b'{"key": "castor-batch-data"}'
    expected_sha256 = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
    expected_md5 = hashlib.md5(payload).hexdigest()

    assert len(expected_sha256) == 64
    assert len(expected_md5) == 32
    assert hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() == expected_sha256
    assert hashlib.md5(payload).hexdigest() == expected_md5


# =========================================================================
# 4. Compute Engine Metadata Server Interaction Tests
# =========================================================================

def test_get_metadata_attribute_from_env(monkeypatch):
    """Metadata lookup should prioritize environment variables if present."""
    monkeypatch.setenv("TEST_ATTR", "env-override-value")
    with patch("urllib.request.urlopen") as mock_urlopen:
        val = worker.get_metadata_attribute("TEST_ATTR")
        assert val == "env-override-value"
        mock_urlopen.assert_not_called()


def test_get_metadata_attribute_from_server(mock_http_response):
    """Metadata lookup calls internal metadata server when env var is absent."""
    resp = mock_http_response(b"server-provided-value")
    with patch("urllib.request.urlopen", return_value=resp) as mock_urlopen:
        val = worker.get_metadata_attribute("COMPLETION_TOPIC_ID")
        assert val == "server-provided-value"
        mock_urlopen.assert_called_once()
        req = mock_urlopen.call_args[0][0]
        assert req.headers.get("Metadata-flavor") == "Google"
        assert "COMPLETION_TOPIC_ID" in req.full_url


def test_get_metadata_attribute_404_with_default():
    """Metadata lookup returning HTTP 404 returns default when provided."""
    http_err = urllib.error.HTTPError("http://metadata/...", 404, "Not Found", {}, None)
    with patch("urllib.request.urlopen", side_effect=http_err):
        val = worker.get_metadata_attribute("OPTIONAL_KEY", default="fallback_val")
        assert val == "fallback_val"


def test_get_metadata_attribute_404_without_default_raises():
    """Metadata lookup returning HTTP 404 raises HTTPError when no default is given."""
    http_err = urllib.error.HTTPError("http://metadata/...", 404, "Not Found", {}, None)
    with patch("urllib.request.urlopen", side_effect=http_err):
        with pytest.raises(urllib.error.HTTPError):
            worker.get_metadata_attribute("MANDATORY_KEY")


def test_get_metadata_attribute_retries_and_exhausts():
    """Metadata lookup retries on network error and raises RuntimeError on exhaustion."""
    with patch("urllib.request.urlopen", side_effect=urllib.error.URLError("Network down")), \
         patch("time.sleep") as mock_sleep:
        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="Failed to retrieve mandatory metadata attribute"):
            worker.get_metadata_attribute("TIMEOUT_KEY")
        assert mock_sleep.call_count == 5


def test_get_project_id_from_env(monkeypatch):
    """Project ID is retrieved from environment if present."""
    monkeypatch.setenv("PROJECT_ID", "castor-test-project")
    assert worker.get_project_id() == "castor-test-project"


def test_get_project_id_from_metadata(mock_http_response):
    """Project ID queries metadata server if not in environment."""
    resp = mock_http_response(b"project-from-meta")
    with patch("urllib.request.urlopen", return_value=resp):
        assert worker.get_project_id() == "project-from-meta"


def test_get_project_id_metadata_failure_returns_empty():
    """Metadata retrieval failure for project ID returns empty string gracefully."""
    with patch("urllib.request.urlopen", side_effect=Exception("Connection reset")):
        assert worker.get_project_id() == ""


def test_get_access_token_success(mock_http_response):
    """OAuth2 access token is extracted from service account metadata JSON payload."""
    payload = json.dumps({"access_token": "ya29.mock_token_abc", "expires_in": 3600}).encode("utf-8")
    resp = mock_http_response(payload)
    with patch("urllib.request.urlopen", return_value=resp):
        token = worker.get_access_token()
        assert token == "ya29.mock_token_abc"


def test_get_access_token_failure_raises():
    """Access token lookup failure raises RuntimeError after exhausting retries."""
    with patch("urllib.request.urlopen", side_effect=Exception("Token endpoint unavailable")), \
         patch("time.sleep"):
        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="Failed to acquire OAuth2 access token"):
            worker.get_access_token()


# =========================================================================
# 5. Cloud Storage REST API Tests
# =========================================================================

def test_gcs_download_success(mock_http_response):
    """gcs_download downloads raw bytes with proper Authorization header and URL escaping."""
    resp = mock_http_response(b"cloud-storage-file-contents")
    with patch("urllib.request.urlopen", return_value=resp) as mock_urlopen:
        content = worker.gcs_download("my-bucket", "inputs/sub/file name.json", "test-token")
        assert content == b"cloud-storage-file-contents"

        req = mock_urlopen.call_args[0][0]
        assert req.headers["Authorization"] == "Bearer test-token"
        assert "inputs%2Fsub%2Ffile%20name.json" in req.full_url
        assert "my-bucket" in req.full_url


def test_gcs_upload_success(mock_http_response):
    """gcs_upload uploads raw bytes with POST method and returns gs:// URI."""
    resp = mock_http_response(b'{"kind": "storage#object", "id": "summary.json"}')
    with patch("urllib.request.urlopen", return_value=resp) as mock_urlopen:
        test_data = b'{"result": "success"}'
        uri = worker.gcs_upload("output-bucket", "outputs/job-1/summary.json", test_data, "test-token")

        assert uri == "gs://output-bucket/outputs/job-1/summary.json"
        req = mock_urlopen.call_args[0][0]
        assert req.method == "POST"
        assert req.data == test_data
        assert req.headers["Authorization"] == "Bearer test-token"
        assert req.headers["Content-type"] == "application/json"


# =========================================================================
# 6. Pub/Sub Notification REST API Tests
# =========================================================================

def test_pubsub_publish_with_short_topic_name(mock_http_response, monkeypatch):
    """pubsub_publish formats short topic name into full projects/.../topics path."""
    monkeypatch.setenv("PROJECT_ID", "castor-prod")
    resp = mock_http_response(b'{"messageIds": ["msg-123"]}')
    with patch("urllib.request.urlopen", return_value=resp) as mock_urlopen:
        payload = {"job_id": "job-abc", "status": "COMPLETED"}
        worker.pubsub_publish("batch-completions", payload, "token-123")

        req = mock_urlopen.call_args[0][0]
        assert "projects/castor-prod/topics/batch-completions:publish" in req.full_url
        assert req.headers["Authorization"] == "Bearer token-123"

        sent_body = json.loads(req.data.decode("utf-8"))
        assert len(sent_body["messages"]) == 1
        msg = sent_body["messages"][0]
        assert msg["attributes"] == {"job_id": "job-abc", "status": "COMPLETED"}

        decoded_inner_data = json.loads(base64.b64decode(msg["data"]).decode("utf-8"))
        assert decoded_inner_data == payload


def test_pubsub_publish_with_fully_qualified_topic(mock_http_response):
    """pubsub_publish uses fully qualified topic without prepending project prefix."""
    resp = mock_http_response(b'{"messageIds": ["msg-456"]}')
    full_topic = "projects/custom-project/topics/custom-topic"
    with patch("urllib.request.urlopen", return_value=resp) as mock_urlopen:
        worker.pubsub_publish(full_topic, {"status": "FAILED"}, "tok")
        req = mock_urlopen.call_args[0][0]
        assert f"{full_topic}:publish" in req.full_url


# =========================================================================
# 7. System Shutdown / Spot VM Poweroff Tests
# =========================================================================

def test_trigger_poweroff_primary_success():
    """trigger_poweroff attempts sudo poweroff first."""
    with patch("subprocess.run") as mock_run:
        worker.trigger_poweroff()
        mock_run.assert_called_once_with(["sudo", "poweroff"], check=False)


def test_trigger_poweroff_fallback_when_primary_fails():
    """trigger_poweroff falls back to shutdown -h now when sudo poweroff throws."""
    with patch("subprocess.run") as mock_run:
        # First call raises an exception, second succeeds
        mock_run.side_effect = [FileNotFoundError("sudo not found"), MagicMock()]
        worker.trigger_poweroff()
        assert mock_run.call_count == 2
        mock_run.assert_has_calls([
            call(["sudo", "poweroff"], check=False),
            call(["shutdown", "-h", "now"], check=False),
        ])


def test_trigger_poweroff_all_fail_handled_gracefully():
    """trigger_poweroff catches and logs all exceptions without raising."""
    with patch("subprocess.run", side_effect=Exception("All shutdown commands failed")),
         patch("worker.log_json") as mock_log:
        worker.trigger_poweroff()
        mock_log.assert_called_with("ERROR", "Failed to execute shutdown command: All shutdown commands failed")


# =========================================================================
# 8. Main Workflow Integration Tests (Success & Error Paths)
# =========================================================================

def test_main_success_flow(monkeypatch, sample_records_list):
    """End-to-end execution of main() under mocked GCP environment verifies JSON output and PubSub notification."""
    env_config = {
        "COMPLETION_TOPIC_ID": "projects/castor-test/topics/job-finished",
        "INPUTS_BUCKET_NAME": "test-inputs-bucket",
        "OUTPUTS_BUCKET_NAME": "test-outputs-bucket",
        "JOB_ID": "job-success-777",
        "INPUT_FILE": "inputs/job-success-777/data.json",
        "PROJECT_ID": "castor-test",
    }
    for k, v in env_config.items():
        monkeypatch.setenv(k, v)

    sample_bytes = json.dumps(sample_records_list).encode("utf-8")
    uploaded_files = {}
    published_messages = []

    def mock_gcs_download(bucket, file_path, token):
        assert bucket == "test-inputs-bucket"
        assert file_path == "inputs/job-success-777/data.json"
        return sample_bytes

    def mock_gcs_upload(bucket, file_path, data, token, content_type="application/json"):
        uploaded_files[f"{bucket}/{file_path}"] = data
        return f"gs://{bucket}/{file_path}"

    def mock_pubsub(topic, payload, token):
        published_messages.append((topic, payload))

    with patch("worker.get_access_token", return_value="ya29.mock-token"),
         patch("worker.gcs_download", side_effect=mock_gcs_download),
         patch("worker.gcs_upload", side_effect=mock_gcs_upload),
         patch("worker.pubsub_publish", side_effect=mock_pubsub),
         patch("sys.exit") as mock_sys_exit:

        worker.main()
        mock_sys_exit.assert_not_called()

    # Verify output JSON uploaded to GCS
    expected_output_key = "test-outputs-bucket/outputs/job-success-777/summary.json"
    assert expected_output_key in uploaded_files
    summary = json.loads(uploaded_files[expected_output_key].decode("utf-8"))

    # Assert structure and contents of valid JSON aggregate output
    assert summary["job_id"] == "job-success-777"
    assert summary["status"] == "COMPLETED"
    assert summary["record_count"] == 3
    assert summary["input_uri"] == "gs://test-inputs-bucket/inputs/job-success-777/data.json"
    assert summary["checksums"]["input_sha256"] == hashlib.sha256(sample_bytes).hexdigest()
    assert summary["checksums"]["input_md5"] == hashlib.md5(sample_bytes).hexdigest()
    assert len(summary["checksums"]["output_sha256"]) == 64
    assert len(summary["checksums"]["output_md5"]) == 32
    assert summary["metrics"]["parsed_records"] == 3
    assert "metric_a" in summary["metrics"]["numeric_metrics"]

    # Verify Pub/Sub notification payload
    assert len(published_messages) == 1
    pubsub_topic, pubsub_payload = published_messages[0]
    assert pubsub_topic == "projects/castor-test/topics/job-finished"
    assert pubsub_payload["job_id"] == "job-success-777"
    assert pubsub_payload["status"] == "COMPLETED"
    assert pubsub_payload["output_uri"] == f"gs://{expected_output_key}"
    assert pubsub_payload["result"]["record_count"] == 3
    assert pubsub_payload["error"] is None


def test_main_failure_publishes_error_and_exits(monkeypatch):
    """When an unhandled exception occurs, main publishes FAILED status and calls sys.exit(1)."""
    env_config = {
        "COMPLETION_TOPIC_ID": "projects/castor-test/topics/job-finished",
        "INPUTS_BUCKET_NAME": "test-inputs-bucket",
        "OUTPUTS_BUCKET_NAME": "test-outputs-bucket",
        "JOB_ID": "job-fail-999",
        "INPUT_FILE": "nonexistent.json",
    }
    for k, v in env_config.items():
        monkeypatch.setenv(k, v)

    published_messages = []

    def mock_pubsub(topic, payload, token):
        published_messages.append(payload)

    with patch("worker.get_access_token", return_value="mock-token"),
         patch("worker.gcs_download", side_effect=RuntimeError("GCS Object not found 404")),
         patch("worker.pubsub_publish", side_effect=mock_pubsub),
         patch("sys.exit") as mock_sys_exit:

        worker.main()
        mock_sys_exit.assert_called_once_with(1)

    assert len(published_messages) == 1
    failure_event = published_messages[0]
    assert failure_event["job_id"] == "job-fail-999"
    assert failure_event["status"] == "FAILED"
    assert failure_event["output_uri"] is None
    assert "RuntimeError: GCS Object not found 404" in failure_event["error"]


def test_main_failure_without_token_exits_safely(monkeypatch):
    """If token acquisition fails, main catches error, skips pubsub without crashing, and exits 1."""
    monkeypatch.setenv("COMPLETION_TOPIC_ID", "projects/test/topics/topic")
    monkeypatch.setenv("INPUTS_BUCKET_NAME", "bucket")
    monkeypatch.setenv("OUTPUTS_BUCKET_NAME", "bucket")
    monkeypatch.setenv("JOB_ID", "job-no-token")
    monkeypatch.setenv("INPUT_FILE", "input.json")

    with patch("worker.get_access_token", side_effect=RuntimeError("Metadata service unavailable")),
         patch("worker.pubsub_publish") as mock_pubsub,
         patch("sys.exit") as mock_sys_exit:

        worker.main()
        mock_pubsub.assert_not_called()
        mock_sys_exit.assert_called_once_with(1)
